title: Client creation file (Finspot OMS, Investor Client)
purpose: Creates (or updates) client logins on Finspot from Ledgerline's client master: one line per active client that is new or changed since the last file (or every active client, for the first load). The password and transaction password are never written: they are left empty and Finspot sets them. Login ID and account ID are the UCC; branch and client group are the client's branch (HO when none); the residence address is the correspondence address from the UCC details; DP ID and account from the client's demat account; decimal preference 2; status A; user role name, second client type and access type from the Finspot connection (INVESTOR, Online-Sqroff, TWS when not set); client type Retail unless the connection says otherwise; user status E (enabled). Office address, office phone, MICR, DP name and RMS category are left empty (Ledgerline does not hold them). A pipe or line break inside a value is replaced by a space.

columns.name: Branch Id
columns.note: The client's branch, HO when none

columns.name: Password
columns.note: Never written by Ledgerline: Finspot sets it

columns.name: Transaction Password
columns.note: Never written by Ledgerline: Finspot sets it

columns.name: DP id
columns.note: First 8 digits of a CDSL BO ID (12…), or the NSDL DP ID (IN…)

columns.name: DP account number
columns.note: The demat account as Ledgerline holds it

columns.name: DOB
columns.note: dd-mm-yyyy, as in the sample line
